notes.title: A little conclusion and our new project!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

First of all, I would like to summarize the past year during which a lot has happened to us, and we have gained huge amount of experience and many new friends!

Over a year ago, we released our first official horror game [b]Remorse: The List[/b] on Steam, followed by console ports and a free DLC. I think we can confidently say that we've told everything about this story that we wanted to. With your help, we managed to hunt down numerous bugs, smoothed out the game's difficulty in certain parts, and realized that it doesn't hurt if the player always has a slightly bigger inventory than what we planned. We hope that everyone who wanted to enjoy the game was able to do so on all platforms, and we sincerely [b]thank you for your enthusiastic contribution to make the game even better![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34510679/86995b7abdc17aecf43d90851e4911bc96b418c0.png[/img]

From now on, we consider this game finished (aside from support and bug fixes, of course), and we have been working on our next project, which I would like to talk about briefly.

Since I've always been a huge fan of horror, it will be evident in our next game as well. However, I wanted to change the genre of the game a bit because I felt that we should challenge ourselves in a new area. I often play cooperative FPS games with my friends, which have always been close to my heart, partly because we can chat while playing with friends and meet new people on the Discord servers of these games. That's why I thought I could create my own dark, bloody horror game in this category, spiced up with a large dose of replayability and randomness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34510679/48ab444beeb6acfb0c99ffb991c9f230bb9a3461.jpg[/img]

And that's how the idea for [b]BloodSworn[/b] was born, which will be a Cooperative Roguelite FPS with blood magic, sick looking, weird monsters, and a very dark world.

In the past six months, we've put a tremendous amount of work into designing it and have been working tirelessly to reach a stable and visually stunning prototype version of the game. According to our plans, this version will be done within a few months, allowing us to create the first official announcement trailer for the game. In the meantime, you can see some images from BloodSworn [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2515660/BloodSworn/]on the game's Steam profile[/url][/b], and don't forget to [b]add it to your wishlist if you like it![/b]

[b]So, we would like to thank everyone who bought our game or helped us create it, those who supported us with a like or share, those who eagerly awaited our game, those who impressed us with their speedruns, and those who stay in touch with us on our Discord server on a daily basis![/b] 

[i]Now it's time to prepare for a new adventure![/i]

notes.title: The first merch for the game!
notes.content:
Due to Remorse: The List's huge success, everyone can buy the game's first, commercially available toy from today! Take on the role of the wall monster and attack Adrian anywhere and anytime!

Be the first one to deal the most damage while clinging to walls, chairs, and windows, so that our poor hero will use as many first aid kits as possible and finally have free space in his inventory!

[previewyoutube=6fC7Qvlci_Y;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Third Episode of our Behind the Scenes series is out!
notes.content:
Hello, fearless survivors!

As everyone knows, enemies are a very important part of a survival horror game, so we tried to make them as scary and deadly as possible. In the second episode, we get to know some of the enemies in the game and the concepts behind them, and we also touch on some interesting game mechanics related to them. Please enjoy the third journey behind the scenes of the game!

[previewyoutube=XkTrJ1DJVo8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Another Past DLC is available NOW!
notes.content:
Hello fellow survivors!

We are happy to inform everyone that [b]the official DLC of Remorse: The List, Another Past, has been released[/b], which can be downloaded as a free update for those who have already bought the game and accesible from the main menu for everyone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34510679/5d14b8b5e807a850fdc985ea7beb2be2b54bc4de.png[/img]

If you don't have the game, you can now get it for 15% cheaper during a quick sale, so that you can experience the awesome adventure provided by the game together with the DLC!

[b]We wish everyone a good time and don't forget: always keep a spare battery for your flashlights with you![/b]

notes.title: Important update regarding the console versions and the DLC!
notes.content:
Greetings, survivors!

Today we have two new pieces of information to give to you.

First and foremost is that the [b]DLC, Another Past, will be available on Steam through an update tomorrow, February 23rd at 17:00 GMT.[/b] We will be looking forward to your opinions and thoughts about the content of the DLC which we hope you enjoy!

The second piece of news is that the console versions coming out tomorrow for the Switch and Xbox [u]will only contain the base game and the DLC will come at a later date through an update[/u]. This is due to an unexpected technical issue, so we beg you to be patient and enjoy the base game for now.

Thank you all and see you on the next adventure!

notes.title: Remorse: The List DLC and console Release dates!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings to all survivors![/b]

Since the game was released, we have been working hard on two big things related to Remorse: The List and we have good news that we'd like to take the opportunity to announce.

[b]DLC: Another Past[/b]

As a bit of a surprise release, we're launching next week, February 23rd, a completely free DLC for Remorse: The List, named Another Past.

Another Past is a new adventure that offers you a new perspective of the story in Remorse: The List filled with puzzles and lore!

[b]Console Versions[/b]

These last few months, we've been working with Feardemic to make Remorse: The List be available on consoles!

We spent quite a few sleepless nights, tirelessly working on the console versions with Feardemic, but in the end, the hard work paid off!

We're happy to announce that console versions will be available the same day as the DLC we just announced on February 23rd! Console versions already include the new DLC. The game will first come to Xbox and the Switch, but they will soon be followed by a Playstation 4 version in the near future.

We also prepared a new trailer for the console release!

[previewyoutube=TkVm0ecFsM4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Second Episode of our Behind the Scenes series is out!
notes.content:
Hello, fearless survivors!

The second part of the behind the scenes video series has arrived, which gives an insight into the history of the game and the background of the characters. Since one of the most important parts of the game is the story, we paid special attention to make sure the story is understandable, but there is also room for theories. You can now see into this thought process with the help of this video.

[previewyoutube=rj8inuJ1fdY;full][/previewyoutube]
We also received a very surprising and joyful news, which is that [b]our game was included in the top 100 indie games at IndieDB's indie of the year award[/b] and the voting is still going! We would like to thank everyone who supported us and if you liked the game, make sure to drop a vote for us!

[url=https://www.indiedb.com/groups/2022-indie-of-the-year-awards/top100#vote45524][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34510679/b55f8f4ba5d87144a8b634b52c37a599352fe868.png[/img][/url]

Thank you guys!

notes.title: Remorse: The List is in the top 100 of Indie of the Year Awards!
notes.content:
Welcome fellow survivors stumbling around in the dark, looking for batteries for their flashlights!

First of all, we want to thank everyone who voted for our game! We are very pleased that you thought about our game when the voting took place and it is a special surprise that [b]the game made it into the top 100![/b]

Lately, we've been a bit overwhelmed with work related to DLC, making the behind-the-scenes videos, and doing the work required for console ports. But it's always a good feeling when, with the help of such an event and great people, we get a new push for development and throw ourselves into work with renewed energy!

notes.title: First Episode of our Behind the Scenes series is out!
notes.content:
Hello guys!

On this foggy and rainy autumn day, we prepared a small situation report and a video for you. We will talk about the console version of the game and a new Behind the Scenes series!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34510679/88701fd1003960e940b42f1ed5d6c6b24688316d.png[/img]

Some of you may already know it, but among the console versions of the game, the xbox and nintendo switch versions will arrive first. Since the porting is going well thanks to the Feardemic team, we don't have to wait long for the release, which will fall in the first quarter of 2023. The playstation version will arrive a little later, but we hope you don't miss it!

[previewyoutube=PuczmA6lb9o;full][/previewyoutube]

The other news I want to tell you about is our new video series about the game, which will be a five part Behind the Scenes collection. The first part will be about the level design of the game, where you will see what references we used while developing the game's envrionments.

Enjoy the video and take care in the dark!

notes.title: Upcoming DLC and Steam Community Items!
notes.content:
Welcome survivors!

We decided since a few months have passed, it's about time for a little status report on the game!

First of all, we would like to thank everyone who bought our game and continues to support us either on discord or on the official steam forums. Thanks to the many bugs submitted by you, we managed to make it into a very stable version of the game in just a few months, which then can be built on in the future!

And now we are happy to announce that the game's first DLC will be a short, single player story, which runs on the working name Four Walls. This will be a slightly different experience than the main story of the game, with smaller, confined spaces and more puzzles, we hope you like the idea! Since there are several tasks going on in parallel in the background, it will take quite a few months to complete this new story. The DLC will be available for free as an update for those who have purchased the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34510679/a63da4503239bb64a67d829fa5a613104910b365.png[/img]

Something else we've been working on recently is the steam community items with cards, profile backgrounds and badges. After a few checks, these will soon be coming to steam for everyone to collect and trade! We hope everyone will like these little extras and we will see some profile backgrounds among our players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34510679/9251756c16d899c1e93c09ea0ff35b41e448220f.png[/img]

Thank you very much for your attention, we hope you are happy with the announcements and as much excited about them as we are! See you next time, when hopefully we can provide you with even more good news like these!

Take care!

notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.content:
- Items now have an outline when you get close to them.
- Fixed the City's Map pickup description.
- Fixed other small issues.

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.content:
- Added new item "Leg Pouch" for people who take a long time to get an upgrade.
- Fixed issue where some people couldn't pick up the Stone Key.
- Fixed several out of bounds glitches.
- Reduced flashlight consumption.
- Fixed error in the shotgun's description.

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
Gameplay
- Fixed some first aid kits not restoring as they should.
- Challenge 03 has received some adjustments to be framerate independent.
- Made disc puzzle clues more obvious.
- Added clues for beating the Water Tank puzzle.
- Added more batteries for the Normal difficulty.
- Fixed small issues in Phase 3 of the final boss.

Options
- FPS Cap increased up to 360.
- Added unlimited FPS option. (Choose 0 in Framerate Cap)

Extras
- New content added to the Museum.

notes.title: Hotfix 4
notes.content:
- Fixed gamebreaking bug that prevented the final battle from being beaten.
- Challenges now unlocks when beating the game in normal. (Works retroactively by getting in the main menu if you have beaten the game.)

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Gameplay
- Made some puzzle items more visible.
- Adjusted ammo packs for some weapons.
- Adjusted weapon damage.
- Fixed issue where you could get blown away in final battle.
- Reduced general volume of a sound in final battle.

Settings
- Added an option to invert the Y axis camera movement when controlling the character.

Others
- Added version number to the title screen.

notes.title: Hotfix 3
notes.content:
- Fixed some out of bounds issues.
- Corrected text in some textures that had some grammar issues.
- Corrected text for the water tank puzzle which had misleading number of crowns.

notes.title: Hotfix 2
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where the revolver and the pistol had the same description.
- Fixed issue where you couldn't die at the Doctor's house in the traps.

notes.title: Hotfix 1
notes.content:
- Fixed small issues related to out of bounds glitches.
- Fixed the Paper puzzle being glitched.

notes.title: Two days until release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34510679/84c25c2167091c8f855854bb59bca49bd9a00879.png[/img]

It’s really hard to believe, but we have reached the end of development and in two days, the game we've been working on for literally years will come out! However, the story is not over yet. We are aware that we will have to work actively on the game after the release, paying attention to all Your feedback!

We would be overjoyed if after playing through the game, You came and talk with us about it!
We look forward to seeing You on our [url=https://t.co/1SYvYJCB07]discord server[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34510679/86995b7abdc17aecf43d90851e4911bc96b418c0.png[/img]

And now, we want to take this opportunity to thank everyone who has supported us in recent years. Lots of old acquaintances and friends we got to know from the old modding era, as well as newcomers who joined our little community as the game was being developed!

We owe a lot to You because You are the soul of it all, the players who shiver through these creations and support us until the game is released!

[b]Thank You on behalf of the whole team![/b]

Take good care of yourselves and see You soon with the game in Your hands!

Cheers!

notes.title: Remorse: The List - Trailer and Release date announcement!
notes.content:
We’ve been working on the game a lot these last months, thanks to which we’ve been able to make tremendous progress!

A new trailer for the game is available today, which will officially reveal the release date of the game!

[previewyoutube=LXTDrL71A4s;full][/previewyoutube]

After many years, on a rather bumpy road, we've finally gotten to the point where the game will be released! You wouldn’t believe how good it feels and the huge excitement we're feeling to finally write this announcement with a release date in our hands!

The official release date is April 22nd, 2022!

Enjoy the trailer and if you feel like it, wishlist the game!

notes.title: Progress Report
notes.content:
Hi!

After a long silence, it's time for a progress report on the game's current state, our experiences as of late, and the things we need to finish before the release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34510679/87ce0bc284af295b87b8feab9bd99996717e1407.png[/img]

Before anything else, it is worth mentioning that we had some real life problems lately that delayed the release of the game. As of now, all the problems are solved and we're back on track, doing very good progress on the game. Since our core team is made of only two members, even with our best efforts, it will take some time to complete it. We will be doing our best to shorten this process as much as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34510679/814d64729093de22eeaff43a4c46419edb9b455f.png[/img]

In the last few weeks we made good progress with the enemies, weapons, and levels. Thanks to that, we're happy to announce we tested our very first early alpha version of the full game. Even without the features like multiple endings and some cutscenes, it's a great achievement for us to see our little love project become a reality after years of hard work. We still have a lot of polishing, testing and bug fixing to do, but we are very excited about the stage we have reached with our game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34510679/86995b7abdc17aecf43d90851e4911bc96b418c0.png[/img]

That's it for now, my friends. We will come back with more detailed news as soon as we can!

[b]Take care of yourselves and each other, and don't forget to add the game to your wishlist![/b]

[i]See you next time![/i]
